title: Testers and the first Android upload
summary: Create the "testers" list, upload the first AAB to Play by hand and submit the tester emails.
why: The Play API does not work until the app has its first release, and it cannot manage tester lists. After this one-time setup, `./release.sh mobile android internal` distributes every release to internal + closed testing automatically. The same emails are also added to the TestFlight "testers" group.
prerequisites: The first AAB produced by Claude: `build/app/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab`.

steps.title: Add the "testers" list to Internal testing
steps.detail: **Test and release → Testing → Internal testing → Testers** tab → **Create email list** → name: `testers` → add the emails → **Save**.

steps.title: Upload the first AAB by hand
steps.detail: On the same page, **Create new release** → drag in the AAB → write the release notes → **Next → Save and publish**.

steps.title: Select the same list for Closed testing (Alpha)
steps.detail: **Testing → Closed testing → Alpha → Testers** → check the `testers` list → save. Copy the opt-in link.

steps.title: If it is a new personal account: 12 testers × 14 days
steps.detail: For personal accounts created after 2023, at least **12 testers must test for 14 days** continuously in closed testing before you can move to production. Add at least 12 people to the list.

warnings: Do not act in the wrong account: the account/team name on the page must match the one in the **store-accounts** record (RULES.md Section 12.8).

fields.label: Tester emails (one person per line: email,First name,Last name)
